  },
];

export const PET_TYPES = {
  all: "🐾 All",
  dog: "🐶 Dogs",
  cat: "🐱 Cats",
  bird: "🐦 Birds",
  rabbit: "🐰 Rabbits",
};

// The id from the URL is always a STRING → convert it
export function getPet(id) {
  return pets.find((pet) => pet.id === Number(id));
}

export default pets;
